entries.title: Signed Trail Junction
entries.description: One static signed trail-junction scene for the original navigation route-marking scene program. One complete unchanged forked camping trail marker stands off the inside shoulder of a genuinely connected T-shaped scene-only route: a foreground arrival meets left and right branches. One complete unchanged low companion-scree cluster occupies the opposite rear shoulder as a visual landmark, leaving all three route arms and the central decision area clear. Both existing arrow boards, pegs, triangular mountain symbol, post and finite ground sleeve remain whole; no new arrow, destination label, map texture or flag colour is added. The whole scree geometry and all original per-face solid materials remain unchanged. Only the finite ground and two abutting closed route slabs are scene-only; the slabs are not new reusable road models. Two whole unit-scale unrotated instances from two published models: one scene and zero new independent models. This is a route-decision spatial arrangement, not the existing campsite with a marker beside its tents/fire/table, the forest straight-path vegetation composition, the small map-and-compass planning pad or an instrument survey station renamed. Static fictional visual arrangement only: no actual destination, direction, geographic placement, route planning, optical measurement, accessibility, load or route safety is asserted.

entries.title: Static Braided-Loop Portal Frame
entries.description: One original fantasy portal-frame visual under the approved fantasy-magic portal theme. Two substantial newly authored rails follow different three-dimensional winding paths around one tall open loop: they repeatedly exchange front/back and inner/outer positions while preserving actual gaps between them. Three finite material cross-links grow through removed inward rail patches and make the rail pair one connected closed shared-vertex mesh. Four lower rail ends transition continuously into horizontal closed seats on one broad chamfered threshold plinth, whose complete underside is grounded. The full central opening remains empty, and the smaller inter-rail windows are real negative space; no transparent sheet, painted gap or decorative detached strands. This is not a scaled lifebuoy, a rope coil stood upright, an old masonry arch with symbols, an interior door stripped of its leaf, a channel mine arch duplicated, or an airlock recoloured. All center paths, cross-sections, depth crossings, ports, feet and threshold are new; only generic mesh orientation/ear clipping and mature export/render tools are reused. Two closed editable meshes and four constant opaque matte/satin PBR roles. One static prop, zero scenes, separate rail assets or variants. Metres, native Z up, front -Y, full horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. Fictional ornamental doorway appearance only: no teleportation, magic field, animated energy, passage accessibility, architecture compatibility, working mechanism, manufacturing, load, stability, collision, safe traversal or engineering performance claim.

entries.title: Static Turn-End Luggage Reclaim Corner
entries.description: One static baggage reclaim-corner scene for the original luggage pickup-area program. A complete existing radial quarter-turn roller section stands on the right with its near terminal mouth facing a generous empty approach. A complete slotted side guide stands separately behind the left staging bay, using an exact whole-instance signed-permutation quarter-turn. In front-left a complete arched luggage trolley carries one complete fixed-open deep travel case: both whole skid soles lie within the actual unchanged trolley platform polygon, while all other trolley components remain separate. Four complete old models, unit scale, original raw GLB buffers, internal nodes and per-face PBR preserved. Only one connected apron with low boundary is new scene-only geometry. Unlike the acceptance counter and the loaded three-mouth Y sorting layout, this is a terminal-approach and cart-loading arrangement with no counter, scale, Y junction, scanner or cage. The complete open case is static, not animated or portrayed as moving across rollers. The curved module and guide are deliberately separated and not claimed compatible or connected; no carousel or automatic luggage transfer is implied. One scene, zero new independent models. No conveying operation, throughput, luggage safety, working module connection, airport procedure, handle or wheel motion, certified walkway width or engineering performance is claimed.
